requested_order.text: Wegovy (semaglutide) 0.25 mg SC once weekly x4 weeks, then titrate per label to 2.4 mg weekly

adjunct_diet_and_activity.text:
A/P:
1. Obesity — patient motivated to start a lifestyle plan today.
 - Mediterranean-style reduced-calorie eating, target about 1600 kcal/day, cut out sugar-sweetened drinks.
 - Brisk walking with a coworker during lunch, 4 days a week.
 - Referred to the clinic's Healthy Weight lifestyle program (RD visits + group sessions). Follow-up here in ~3 months.
2. Hyperlipidemia on atorvastatin 20 mg daily; last LDL 154. Continue; repeat lipids in 6 months.
3. Eczema — stable with PRN triamcinolone.

NUTRITION CONSULT — INITIAL
Date: 01/29/2026
Healthy Weight program intake.
Reviewed 5-day food log: restaurant lunches, 2–3 regular sodas, large late dinners, weekend beer (4–6 cans).
Plan:
- Mediterranean-style pattern at ~1600 kcal/day. Pack lunch 3 days/week; at restaurants choose grilled protein + vegetables.
- Zero sugar-sweetened drinks — switch to diet soda or seltzer.
- Limit beer to 2 on weekend days.
- Log intake in the program app.
Activity: brisk lunchtime walks with coworker 4 days/week, as set with PCP.
Group session schedule given. RD follow-up 6 weeks.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 04/25/2026
S: Weight follow-up. Continues the diet and walking plan started in January; packing lunch most days, off regular soda, attending Healthy Weight group sessions. Walks with coworker at lunch most weekdays unless raining. Adherence good most weeks.
O: Wt 94.7 kg, BMI 34.8. BP 118/71.
A/P:
1. Obesity — continue lifestyle program; reinforced goals.
2. Hyperlipidemia on atorvastatin 20 mg daily; last LDL 154. Recheck lipids with next labs.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/11/2026
S: Weight follow-up. Continues the diet and exercise plan and has kept up with the Healthy Weight program visits since January. Still packing lunch, still walking at lunch, no regular soda. Frustrated: weight 92.8 kg today vs 96.0 kg in January when the plan began (-3.3%), and it has not budged since late spring. Asks whether medication is an option. No hx pancreatitis, no personal/family hx MTC or MEN2.
O: Wt 92.8 kg, BMI 34.1. BP 117/67, HR 70.

A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 34.1 — plateau despite adherence. Start semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly (Wegovy) with standard titration starting at 0.25 mg. Discussed GI side effects, small meals, hydration; call for severe abdominal pain or vomiting. Continue lifestyle plan. Recheck in 3 months.
2. Hyperlipidemia on atorvastatin 20 mg daily; last LDL 154. Fasting lipid panel ordered.
